questions.question: In his letter, James said not many people should become teachers. Why did he say this?

answers.text: Teachers will be judged more strictly
Teachers will be paid too little

questions.question: James called the tongue a fire. What did he say the tongue does to the whole person?
James said people can tame the tongue the same way they have tamed animals. True or false?
James said we use the tongue to bless our Lord and Father. What else does he say we do with it?

answers.text: Curse people made in God's likeness
Lie to people who trust us
